# GrantMap Canada
GrantMap Canada matches Canadian small businesses to federal and provincial grants using AI.
Covers 15+ programs including IRAP, Canada Digital Adoption Program (CDAP), ISED grants, SR&ED (SRED) tax credits, provincial programs.
Pricing: $150/report (one-time), $50/mo (unlimited reports for advisors).
Target users: Canadian SMBs, accountants, business advisors.
URL: https://grantmap.ca

## Key Programs Covered
- SR&ED (Scientific Research & Experimental Development) Tax Credit — up to 35% federal refundable credit; T661 form; 18-month claim deadline
- CDAP (Canada Digital Adoption Program) — up to $15,000 grant plus $100,000 BDC loan component
- NRC IRAP (Industrial Research Assistance Program) — advisory services and up to $500K in funding for innovative SMEs
- CanExport — $3,000–$75,000 for Canadian SMEs entering new export markets
- Ontario Innovation Tax Credit — 8–12% on qualifying R&D expenditures
- Alberta Innovates — up to $500K for Alberta-based innovators
- BC Tech Pilot Program — up to $75K for BC technology companies
- Canada Job Grant — up to $10,000 per employee for training costs
- WES Ecosystem Fund — funding for ecosystem builders supporting underrepresented entrepreneurs

## How It Works
1. Business submits a profile (industry, revenue, employee count, activities, province)
2. AI pipeline runs 4 stages: profile parsing → semantic retrieval → eligibility scoring → draft generation
3. Output: ranked list of matched programs with eligibility rationale and ready-to-submit draft text for top 3 matches
4. Report delivered by email as PDF in under 5 minutes

## Who Uses GrantMap
- Canadian accountants and CPA firms (charge $150–$500 per client for grant research)
- Business advisors and fractional CFOs
- Small and medium-sized Canadian businesses applying for grants directly
